comments.body: How To get this Maori Feather +1 Plunder?

comments.author: Erda
comments.body:
Wanganui, Kakadu - 2,000,000 - Investment - this is to make a replica of the item
the +1 plunder item is plundered from 地方海賊 = local pirates

now as to whether it can be worn by females your guess is as good as mine,
but it doesn't have a 'sex symbol' on it so i guess can be worn by both
